title: wss: maxConcurrentRequests sum-of-connections applies to HTTP/2+ only
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-wss-00 §3 says the maxConcurrentRequests limit applies to 'the sum of in-flight requests across both the HTTP JMAP API endpoint and any open WebSocket connections'. RFC 8887 §4.3.2 qualifies this: 'When using the WebSocket JMAP subprotocol over a binding of HTTP that allows multiplexing of requests (e.g., HTTP/2), this limit applies to the sum...' — the cross-connection sum constraint is specific to HTTP/2+, not HTTP/1.1. The WSS draft overstates the scope. Fix: add the HTTP/2+ qualification or cite RFC 8887 §4.3.2 verbatim.
close_reason: Restored RFC 8887 §4.3.2's HTTP/2+ qualification: sum-across-connections constraint now correctly applies only when using a multiplexing HTTP binding, not unconditionally.
